Donating has never been easier! Click the Amazon Picture to be taken to Hk9s Daily Needs Wishlist!
Thank you for your consideration and donation to Heartland Canines For Veterans. Your donation allows us to help those who have done so much for all of us, the US Veterans by providing them with a properly trained and certified Service Dog. Heartland Canines For Veterans is an IRS recognized 501(c)(3) non-profit organization. IRS EIN 47-4991572. All donations are tax deductible to the extend allowed by law. Simply click on whatever platform you wish to use for your contribution.
